modelMismatch.notice: The model provider answered this turn with {{actual}} instead of {{selected}}
modelMismatch.noticeWithProvider: {{provider}} answered this turn with {{actual}} instead of {{selected}}
modelMismatch.infoSummary: Cindy sent this turn to {{selected}} as you selected, and the model provider returned the reply using {{actual}}.
modelMismatch.infoSummaryWithProvider: Cindy sent this turn to {{selected}} as you selected, and {{provider}} returned the reply using {{actual}}.
modelMismatch.infoCausePolicy: Safety or content policy fallback (some models automatically fall back to an earlier model instead of refusing).
modelMismatch.infoCauseLoad: Temporary rerouting by the model provider during peak load.
modelMismatch.infoCauseGateway: Model mapping or routing rules on a third-party or custom gateway.
modelMismatch.infoActionContinue: No settings change needed: this only affected this turn, and later messages keep requesting {{selected}}.
modelMismatch.infoActionRetry: If this reply does not meet your needs, rephrase your message and send again, or switch to another available model.
modelMismatch.infoActionCheckProvider: If this persists across turns, check your model provider’s quota status or gateway routing settings.

providerSafetyRefusal.title: Why this reply was blocked
providerSafetyRefusal.summary: Cindy sent your request as-is, and the model provider's built-in safety or content policy blocked the response. This is not Cindy moderation or a local plugin block.
providerSafetyRefusal.summaryWithProvider: Cindy sent your request as-is, and {{provider}}'s built-in safety or content policy blocked the response. This is not Cindy moderation or a local plugin block.
providerSafetyRefusal.cause1: The prompt, an attachment, or earlier conversation context triggered the provider’s safety classifier.
providerSafetyRefusal.cause2: An output safety filter stopped the model mid-generation.
providerSafetyRefusal.action1: Retrying the exact same prompt usually hits the same block; rephrase or remove the triggering section before sending again.
providerSafetyRefusal.action2: If earlier context caused the block, start a new task or switch to another model.

overload.title: Why the provider is busy
overload.summary: The model provider is temporarily short on compute capacity (such as peak-load congestion or HTTP 529). This is unrelated to Cindy or your local network.
overload.summaryWithProvider: {{provider}} is temporarily short on compute capacity (such as peak-load congestion or HTTP 529). This is unrelated to Cindy or your local network.
overload.cause1: High demand during peak hours saturated the provider’s capacity for this model.
overload.cause2: Temporary provider maintenance or capacity throttling is active.
overload.action1: No need to restart Cindy or change your network setup—wait a moment and click Retry.
overload.action2: To continue right away, switch to another model or another source in your model group.

streamInterrupted.title: Why the reply was interrupted
streamInterrupted.summary: The model provider dropped the streaming connection before finishing the reply. Cindy did not crash, and completed steps and conversation history are intact.
streamInterrupted.summaryWithProvider: {{provider}} dropped the streaming connection before finishing the reply. Cindy did not crash, and completed steps and conversation history are intact.
streamInterrupted.cause1: A transient server error on the model provider interrupted generation mid-stream.
streamInterrupted.cause2: A third-party or custom relay gateway timed out while streaming a long reply.
streamInterrupted.action1: Click Retry, or send “continue” to have the model pick up from where it stopped.
streamInterrupted.action2: If this repeats across turns, try another model or check your custom gateway’s timeout settings.

upstreamStatus.title: Why a service error was returned
upstreamStatus.summary: Cindy sent your request, but the model provider returned an HTTP {{status}} internal error with no details. This comes from the external service, not Cindy.
upstreamStatus.summaryWithProvider: Cindy sent your request, but {{provider}} returned an HTTP {{status}} internal error with no details. This comes from the external service, not Cindy.
upstreamStatus.cause1: The model provider’s backend experienced a temporary internal failure.
upstreamStatus.cause2: A third-party or self-hosted gateway failed to forward the request or returned a custom 5xx status.
upstreamStatus.action1: Click Retry in a moment; transient upstream blips usually clear quickly.
upstreamStatus.action2: If you use a third-party or custom gateway, check its status and logs, or switch to another provider.

modelAccessDenied.title: Why this model cannot be accessed
modelAccessDenied.summary: The model provider rejected access to this model for the current account. Cindy cannot override provider-side model permissions.
modelAccessDenied.summaryWithProvider: {{provider}} rejected access to this model for your current account. Cindy cannot override {{provider}} model permissions.
modelAccessDenied.cause1: Your current subscription tier or API key does not include access to this model.
modelAccessDenied.cause2: An organization admin restricted the allowed model list, or the model is unavailable in your region.
modelAccessDenied.action1: Switch to another model enabled on your current account to keep going.
modelAccessDenied.action2: Check permissions in your provider console or plan settings; if you just upgraded, reconnect the account and try again.

providerQuotaExceeded.title: Why quota or balance is exhausted
providerQuotaExceeded.summary: The external model provider account you connected has run out of balance or quota and rejected the request. This is separate from your Cindy account.
providerQuotaExceeded.summaryWithProvider: Your connected {{provider}} account has run out of balance or quota, so {{provider}} rejected the request. This is separate from your Cindy account.
providerQuotaExceeded.cause1: Prepaid credits on the provider account are depleted, or no valid payment method is attached.
providerQuotaExceeded.cause2: A spend cap on this API key or organization quota has been reached.
providerQuotaExceeded.action1: Top up your balance or raise the spend limit on the provider’s billing page, then click Retry.
providerQuotaExceeded.action2: Or switch to another provider with available quota in the model selector.

usageLimit.title: Why the usage limit was reached
usageLimit.summary: Your connected model account hit the periodic usage window set by the model provider and cannot accept new requests right now. This limit is not imposed by Cindy.
usageLimit.summaryWithProvider: Your connected {{provider}} account hit the periodic usage window set by {{provider}} and cannot accept new requests right now. This limit is not imposed by Cindy.
usageLimit.cause1: Your subscription used up its allowance for the current window (such as a 5-hour or weekly cap).
usageLimit.cause2: Multiple tasks or devices sharing the same account count toward the same usage window.
usageLimit.action1: Wait for the window to reset and retry; if auto-continue is armed, the task will resume automatically.
usageLimit.action2: To continue immediately, switch to another model, another connected subscription account, or an API provider.

encryptedContent.title: Why some history cannot be read
encryptedContent.summary: Some models store encrypted internal reasoning in conversation history that only the original provider and account can decrypt. After switching providers/accounts or compacting remotely, the current provider may be unable to read older encrypted blocks.
encryptedContent.summaryWithProvider: Some models store encrypted internal reasoning in conversation history that only the original provider and account can decrypt. After switching providers/accounts or compacting remotely, {{provider}} may be unable to read older encrypted blocks.
encryptedContent.cause1: You switched to a different model provider or account that cannot decrypt earlier encrypted reasoning.
encryptedContent.cause2: Remote context compaction or cross-endpoint routing did not match the key used for earlier turns.
encryptedContent.action1: Switch back to the original provider or account to continue this task directly.
encryptedContent.action2: Or choose “Continue in a new task”—Cindy keeps all readable conversation history and strips unreadable encrypted blocks while leaving the original task intact.

failedSamplingAttempt.title: Why an incomplete reply is shown
failedSamplingAttempt.summary: The model failed or was interrupted before finishing this reply, producing only partial output. Cindy kept the partial text visible for reference so useful context is not lost.
failedSamplingAttempt.cause1: A provider error, connection drop, or safety block interrupted streaming mid-reply.
failedSamplingAttempt.cause2: The turn errored or stopped before the response could finalize.
failedSamplingAttempt.action1: Check the error card below for the specific failure reason and whether you should retry.
failedSamplingAttempt.action2: Click Retry or send a follow-up message to continue—you can reference the partial text without starting over.
